name: memhub
description: XTrace MemHub team memory in Cursor: search_memory / save_artifact / import_conversation tools plus skills for setup, login, onboarding, artifact upload, session import, recall, handoff, spec-driven development, Rulebook rule authoring (create-rule) and rules proposed from CLAUDE.md + past sessions in one run (rules-from-sessions), and PR babysitting. A rule lives in a RULEBOOK — a container with its own membership, so it reaches exactly the people that book binds; the authoring skills resolve which book it lands in and offer to create one when there is none. Sessions are captured automatically.
